title: Recursive Factorial Evaluation

visualization.title: Recursive Call Stack Tree & Return Unwinding
visualization.content:
graph TD
    A["fact(5) = 5 * fact(4)"] --> B["fact(4) = 4 * fact(3)"]
    B --> C["fact(3) = 3 * fact(2)"]
    C --> D["fact(2) = 2 * fact(1)"]
    D --> E["fact(1) returns 1 (Base Case)"]
    E -. "returns 1" .-> D
    D -. "returns 2" .-> C
    C -. "returns 6" .-> B
    B -. "returns 24" .-> A
    A -. "returns 120" .-> RES["Output: 120"]
    style E fill:#161b22,stroke:#d29922,stroke-width:2px,color:#f0f6fc
    style RES fill:#161b22,stroke:#3fb950,stroke-width:2px,color:#f0f6fc
visualization.caption: Visualization of the recursive activation tree, descending down to base case n=1 and unwinding back up.
